programme.title: The One S1 E1
programme.desc: Salah satu anggota tim SMBG tiba-tiba keluar dari tim seminggu sebelum pendaftaran liga profesional Fights of Legend ditutup. Robin dan anggota SMBG (ZEE, ABBY, SACHA, ODRIE) pun bergegas mencari anggota baru. Hingga akhirnya Robin menemukan pengganti untuk timnya, yaitu Bara, mantan pro player yang pernah dituduh melakukan kecurangan dalam pertandingan.

programme.title: The One S1 E2
programme.desc: Terjadi perpecahan di antara anggota SMBG: apakah mereka harus menerima Bara atau tidak? Sacha menengahi perdebatan tersebut dengan membujuk anggota tim agar menerima Bara. Setelah diyakinkan oleh Robin, Bara bersedia bergabung kembali dengan tim SMBG. Namun, tim SMBG belum sepenuhnya bersatu, terlebih setelah mereka menerima kabar bahwa pendaftaran mereka untuk liga profesional ditolak.

programme.title: The One S1 E3
programme.desc: Pendaftaran SMBG ditolak karena rekam jejak Bara yang pernah melakukan kecurangan dalam pertandingan profesional. Zee ingin Bara keluar, tetapi keputusan Bara untuk tetap bertahan sudah bulat. Satu-satunya jalan bagi tim SMBG untuk masuk ke liga profesional adalah dengan memenangkan liga semi-profesional.

programme.title: The One S1 E4
programme.desc: Tim SMBG mulai mendapatkan popularitas berkat Bara. Robin juga menunjuk Bara sebagai kapten untuk meningkatkan popularitas tim. Hal ini menciptakan suasana tegang antara Bara dan Zee. Namun, tim SMBG terus memenangkan pertandingan demi pertandingan hingga akhirnya berhasil melaju ke babak final meskipun dalam kondisi seperti itu.

programme.title: The One S1 E5
programme.desc: Tim SMBG menerima kabar buruk bahwa dana dari para investor mereka diblokir untuk waktu yang belum ditentukan. Dengan kekuatan masing-masing, para anggota tim SMBG akhirnya bekerja sama untuk mengumpulkan dana guna mendukung operasional tim.

programme.title: The One S1 E6
programme.desc: Zee menerima tawaran dari Indra berupa uang dan fasilitas mewah jika ia bersedia bergabung dengan tim Archon. Zee belum menyetujui tawaran tersebut, namun hal itu membuatnya sulit berkonsentrasi menjalani aktivitas bersama tim SMBG. Ia sering absen karena gangguan yang diberikan Indra. Hal ini menyebabkan keretakan di dalam tim SMBG.

programme.title: The One S1 E7
programme.desc: Bara mulai mengungkap tanda-tanda kedekatan Zee dengan tim Archon. Seluruh tim pun dikumpulkan untuk saling berbagi perasaan dan masalah selama bergabung dengan tim SMBG. Meskipun diwarnai berbagai perdebatan sengit, pada akhirnya mereka menyadari bahwa seluruh tim adalah sebuah keluarga dan harus tetap bersatu.

programme.title: The One S1 E8
programme.desc: Robin berhasil mengatasi gangguan dari tim Archon. Kini tim SMBG siap menghadapi final regional yang akan mengantarkan mereka menjadi juara. Di babak final tersebut, ternyata mereka harus berhadapan dengan tim Archon.

programme.desc: Pemerintah mempekerjakan Yang untuk mengawal muatan emas ke daerah yang dilanda kelaparan. Geng Chi Sha, dengan salah satu petarung terbaik mereka, Golden Arm, berniat melakukan pembajakan dan membunuh karyawan Yang.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: Kisah yang diangkat berdasarkan sebuah opera Tiongkok nan terkenal ini menceritakan seorang sarjana muda nan miskin bernama Zhang yang terpesona oleh Hong, putri dari keluarga berpengaruh yang ia temui di sebuah kuil.

programme.title: Murder Plot
programme.desc: Saat merencanakan pembalasan terhadap Huan yang kejam, istri Shen Lang mengacaukan konferensi dan harus diantar pulang. Dalam perjalanan pulang, mereka terjebak dalam perangkap Huan yang mematikan.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities
programme.desc: Urusan asmara dan moral di era modern hanyalah segelintir masalah dari cerita yang berlatarkan Makau ini. Kisah cinta antara empat anak manusia menjadi cerita utama dalam kisah humor ini.

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats
programme.desc: Tou Kuan adalah seorang pemuda cerdas dari keluarga berada. Ia telah mengalahkan semua penduduk di kotanya dan memutuskan untuk menaklukkan Tiga Pemuda Cerdas dari Utara.

programme.title: A Place To Call Home
programme.desc: Saat mengetahui jika dirinya adalah anak adopsi, Li Ching pergi untuk mencari keluarganya. Ketika situasi yang dialaminya menjadi semakin memburuk, ia akhirnya menyadari bahwa rumah adalah tempat yang terbaik.

programme.title: The Blue And The Black
programme.desc: Berlatar pada masa kependudukan Jepang saat PD II, Tang Qi yang merupakan yatim piatu jatuh cinta dengan pemuda bernama Chang. Namun, cinta mereka dipenuhi tantangan, seperti tekanan keluarga hingga gejolak perang.

programme.title: The Blue And The Black
programme.desc: Berlatar pada masa kependudukan Jepang saat PD II, Tang Qi yang merupakan yatim piatu jatuh cinta dengan pemuda bernama Chang. Namun, cinta mereka dipenuhi tantangan, seperti tekanan keluarga hingga gejolak perang.

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: Pada awal tiga dekade, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, dan Pan Ying-tzu menampilkan superstar internasional Shaw yang pertama, Lo Lieh untuk Han Family Sword memberikan suguhan bintang empat untuk penggemar film laga ini.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Setelah membunuh seekor harimau, Wu Sung mendapat kenaikan jabatan, namun ia malah terjebak dalam cinta segitiga yang tragis antara saudaranya yang buruk rupa dan istri saudaranya yang mencoba untuk menggodanya.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: Chen Chi-chin kalah banyak dari penjudi berpengalaman Hu Kuan-ten. Ayahnya kalah dalam permainan kartu dan mati karena kaget. Chen meminta bantuan pamannya yang memanggil 7 rekan penjudi untuk melampiaskan dendam.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Penipu cantik bernama Hua mencuri sebuah cincin berlian dari toko di Hong Kong dan kabur ke Singapura. Untuk menghindari bea cukai, ia memasukkan cincin itu ke dalam saku pria asing, tapi ia kehilangan jejaknya.

programme.title: The Black Lizard
programme.desc: Pendekar pedang Lung Fei menemukan tanda-tanda aneh yang meramalkan kematian tunangannya. Dengan bantuan Kepala Polisi Tieh Hu, ia melakukan penyelidikan dan mengungkap sebuah kisah yang mencengangkan.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: Si cantik Jenny Hu berperan sebagai Judy, sang penggoda yang merayu tiga pria berbeda: seorang pria kaya, seorang playboy seksi, dan seorang pria terpelajar nan sensitif dalam pencariannya akan uang, seks dan cinta.

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: Dua pangeran berseteru memperebutkan takhta di Dinasti Qing. Bisakah wanita pembunuh yang terlibat dalam perseteruan kerajaan ini menjalankan misinya demi membantu salah satu pangeran mendapatkan takhta?

programme.title: Masked Avengers
programme.desc: Para pembunuh bertopeng membuat kekacauan dan menebar teror dengan bersenjatakan trisula tajam yang mampu mengoyak tubuh manusia. Hanya tiga pendekar pemberani yang bersedia mencari tahu identitas mereka.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar berbakat, Bo Hu, tertarik dengan seorang pelayan nan cantik, Qiu Xiang. Agar dapat mendekatinya dan memenangkan cintanya, ia menyamar sebagai seorang pelayan untuk bekerja di rumah yang sama.

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: Aksi kepahlawanan dan kisah asmara mewarnai film seni bela diri klasik ini. Saat Shaolin dikhianati oleh Pertapa Alis Putih, Fong Sai Yuk sang prajurit pemarah bersumpah untuk membalas dendam.

programme.title: The Battle Wizard
programme.desc: Pangeran Dali yang bernama Tuan Yu memutuskan untuk meninggalkan istana demi mempelajari dunia seni bela diri. Lalu, ia bertemu dengan sesosok penyihir ular dan saudara tirinya yang misterius.

programme.title: The Thundering Sword
programme.desc: Yu, murid sang Guru Besar, dan Chiao Chiao, putri dari musuh bebuyutannya, berada dalam masalah saat mereka jatuh cinta. Hal ini diperparah ketika Chiao Chiao membunuh seorang pria di klan Yu.

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: Seorang panglima perang jahat menerima 2 murid (Angin & Awan) dalam upaya untuk menjadi tak terkalahkan agar dia dapat menguasai dunia.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: Seorang mata-mata Tiongkok yang telah pensiun selama sepuluh tahun dan mencari nafkah sebagai tukang daging dikirim ke Hong Kong untuk menemukan tengkorak Tyrannosaurus rex yang dicuri.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire
programme.desc: Rencana penguburan ulang seorang tetua kota berubah menjadi bencana ketika jenazah tersebut bangkit kembali menjadi vampir haus darah yang melompat-lompat, mengincar semua orang yang bertanggung jawab menggali kuburan tersebut. Seorang Pendeta Tao dan dua muridnya berusaha menghentikan teror tersebut.

programme.title: Confession Of Pain
programme.desc: Seorang detektif membantu temannya menyelidiki kematian misterius ayah mertuanya.

programme.title: The Mask Of Shura Of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: Klan Black Feather nan jahat menyusup ke wilayah Master Fire Cloud dan mencuri Topeng Shura, sehingga melepaskan roh jahat nan masih bayi. Namun, Master Fire Cloud mengadopsi bayi itu untuk mencegahnya menjadi jahat.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 2
programme.desc: Perampok kuburan menemukan vampir yang diawetkan. Saat mengangkut vampir anak, mantra yang mengikatnya hilang, dan ia berteman dengan penduduk setempat. Vampir orang tua terbangun dan melarikan diri. Tabib herbal mengejar untuk menghancurkan mereka.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: Putra dari keluarga kaya jatuh cinta pada seorang wanita yang hanya akan menikahinya setelah ia menjadi seorang Guru Kung-Fu. Dalam 'Drama Komedi' ini, ia menjadi pahlawan legendaris dengan berusaha menyelamatkan kaisar, dalam pencarian cintanya yang sebenarnya.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: Putra dari keluarga kaya jatuh cinta pada seorang wanita yang hanya akan menikahinya setelah ia menjadi seorang Guru Kung-Fu. Dalam 'Drama Komedi' ini, ia menjadi pahlawan legendaris dengan berusaha menyelamatkan kaisar, dalam pencarian cintanya yang sebenarnya.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: Seorang pria tunanetra, You Ji Ren, bekerja di sebuah pabrik di pulau terpencil. Karena badai, pabrik itu terisolasi dan muncul sesosok monster yang membuat siapa pun berubah menjadi bayangan hitam jika melihatnya.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Fai, yang pernah menjadi juara dunia tinju, melarikan diri ke Makau dari rentenir dan secara tak terduga bertemu Qi, seorang pemuda yang bertekad memenangkan pertandingan tinju.

programme.title: Girl With The Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: Lily, adalah seorang gadis biasa yang menjalani kehidupan sederhana. Suatu hari, dalam sebuah pasar antik, dia menemukan sepasang sepatu kaca berlian yang indah. Tanpa disangka, sepatu ini ternyata memiliki kekuatan magis yang dapat mewujudkan impian dan memberikan keberuntungan. Ketika Lily mencoba sepatu tersebut, dia segera menemukan bahwa hidupnya mulai berubah drastis. Dia mendapatkan pekerjaan impiannya, bertemu dengan orang-orang penting, dan bahkan menarik perhatian seorang pangeran modern yang tampan.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang seorang pemadam kebakaran yang rela menerjang bahaya dan mempertaruhkan nyawanya demi menyelamatkan orang lain. Akan tetapi, apakah ia memiliki keberanian untuk menghadapi masalah pribadinya?

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing mengundurkan diri dari kepolisian setelah diturunkan pangkatnya ke bagian pengaturan lalu lintas, sementara rekannya ditugaskan dalam misi yang melibatkan teroris asing yang mengancam akan mengebom sebuah sekolah di Hong Kong, sehingga Sing memutuskan untuk membantu dengan menyamar di sekolah yang sama.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Thongs dan Octopus menerima pekerjaan dari pemilik kontrakan mereka: menculik seorang bayi. Tak lama kemudian, bayi itu membangkitkan perasaan kebapakan yang kuat dalam diri kedua penjahat tersebut, yang menyebabkan komplikasi ketika mereka harus menyerahkan bayi itu kepada kakeknya yang mungkin seorang bos geng gila.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: Sebelum memenangkan pujian dalam film laga berkat aksi-aksi mereka yang berani, para bintang ini menjalani tahun-tahun penuh darah, keringat, dan air mata saat berlatih di bawah bimbingan Master Yu yang kejam.

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords
programme.desc: Hong Kong menjadi medan pertempuran untuk pertarungan antara kebaikan dan kejahatan kala sebuah hadiah senilai 100 juta dolar Hong Kong disiapkan guna memburu pengedar narkoba terbesar di sana.

programme.title: Challenge Of The Gamesters
programme.desc: Wong Jing menciptakan genre film perjudian hampir sendirian, dan dalam salah satu film laris awalnya, Shih Hsien memimpin pemeran bintang dalam kisah tentang mata-mata, taipan, dan gadis cantik.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Kung Fu Jungle mengisahkan seorang instruktur bela diri yang dipenjara setelah sebuah insiden fatal. Ketika seorang pembunuh berantai mulai menargetkan para ahli kung fu, ia bekerja sama dengan polisi dengan imbalan kebebasan. Pertarungan hidup dan mati pun terjadi dalam menghadapi sang pembunuh.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: Seorang Pendeta Taois tidak senang ketika rekan Pendeta Buddha-nya pindah ke sebelah rumahnya. Mereka sering terlibat perselisihan dan duel, tetapi segera harus mengatasi masalah mereka ketika seorang vampir keluar dari peti matinya dan mendatangkan malapetaka di pedesaan.

programme.title: Breaking Through, Ep 5
programme.desc: Dokumenter yang mengangkat perjuangan tim nasional seluncur cepat lintasan pendek Tiongkok dalam mengejar medali emas Olimpiade Musim Dingin 2002, sekaligus menggambarkan perjuangan atlet dan pelatih menghadapi berbagai tantangan.

programme.title: Chronicles Of Long March, Ep 3
programme.desc: Selama perjalanan panjang mereka, Tentara Merah melintasi pegunungan tinggi yang tertutup salju dan menyeberangi padang rumput luas yang tak berpenghuni. Selain musuh dari Kuomintang, mereka juga harus berjuang melawan cuaca yang tak terduga, rawa-rawa, dan kelaparan, memaksakan diri hingga batas ketahanan mereka di beberapa lingkungan terberat di Bumi. Dengan terus maju meskipun dihadapkan pada rintangan-rintangan yang sangat berat di jalur mereka, Tentara Merah menciptakan legenda abadi tentang pengorbanan tanpa rasa takut.

programme.title: The Lijiang River, Ep 2
programme.desc: Selama 20 tahun terakhir, Tiongkok telah menekankan prinsip bahwa perairan yang jernih dan pegunungan yang rimbun merupakan aset yang tak ternilai harganya. Visi ini terlihat jelas di sepanjang Sungai Lijiang di wilayah Guangxi, Tiongkok selatan. Daerah yang dulunya terancam oleh kegiatan penambangan batu, polusi, dan pembangunan yang pesat ini kini telah menjadi contoh restorasi daerah aliran sungai yang terintegrasi.

programme.title: The Horse: A Companion That...
programme.desc: Kisah-kisah nyata yang diceritakan dari sudut pandang pribadi. Amati dengan saksama untuk melihat dan memahami Tiongkok sebagaimana adanya.

programme.title: Song Dynasty Poetry, Ep 4
programme.desc: Memperkenalkan Dinasti Song. Mempelajari bagaimana hal itu terjadi, dan fondasi diletakkan yang memungkinkannya menjadi salah satu dinasti paling ikonik di Tiongkok.

programme.desc: Selama perjalanan panjang mereka, Tentara Merah melintasi pegunungan tinggi yang tertutup salju dan menyeberangi padang rumput luas yang tak berpenghuni. Dengan terus maju meskipun dihadapkan pada rintangan-rintangan yang sangat berat di jalur mereka, Tentara Merah menciptakan legenda abadi tentang pengorbanan tanpa rasa takut.

Visi ini terlihat jelas di sepanjang Sungai Lijiang di wilayah Guangxi, Tiongkok selatan. Daerah yang dulunya terancam oleh kegiatan penambangan batu, polusi, dan pembangunan yang pesat ini kini telah menjadi contoh restorasi daerah aliran sungai yang terintegrasi.

programme.desc: Ahead of the World Cup, we revisit the rise of current USA manager Mauricio Pochettino's unforgettable Tottenham Hotspur side; the team that transformed Spurs from topfour hopefuls into genuine challengers at home and in Europe. Playing fearless, highintensity football and built around a young core of stars, Pochettino's Spurs came within touching distance of Premier League and Champions League glory, creating some of the club's greatest modern nights along the way. Through exclusive interviews with Pochettino and the key players who drove that era, we tell the story of a team that changed expectations forever and ask how something so promising ultimately fell apart.

programme.title: Christmas Ranch
programme.desc: Saat kembali ke peternakan sang kakek menjelang Natal, seorang gadis remaja mengetahui bahwa usaha keluarga sedang menghadapi kesulitan yang mengancam masa depannya. Bertekad mempertahankan warisan tersebut, ia bekerja sama dengan keluarga sambil menghadapi berbagai tantangan dan mempererat kembali hubungan yang sempat merenggang. Dengan latar pedesaan yang hangat, kisah persahabatan dengan kuda, serta semangat kebersamaan di musim Natal, Christmas Ranch menyuguhkan drama keluarga yang penuh inspirasi tentang harapan, ketekunan, dan arti sebuah rumah.

programme.title: Mad Genius
programme.desc: Mason Wells, seorang programmer berbakat dengan pemikiran yang tidak biasa, berhasil mengembangkan teknologi revolusioner yang memungkinkan manusia terhubung dalam dunia bawah sadar yang sama. Penemuannya menarik perhatian pihak-pihak berpengaruh yang ingin memanfaatkan teknologi tersebut demi kepentingan mereka sendiri. Ketika batas antara realitas dan dunia pikiran semakin kabur, Mason harus menghadapi konspirasi, ancaman, dan pertanyaan mendalam mengenai kesadaran, kebebasan, serta dampak dari sebuah inovasi yang melampaui batas kemampuan manusia. Mad Genius memadukan fiksi ilmiah, thriller psikologis, dan misteri dalam sebuah kisah yang penuh ketegangan.

programme.desc: Untuk memenuhi kebutuhan hidupnya sehari-hari, Ines berprofesi sebagai penyanyi dangdut keliling. Pada suatu hari, Bara yang membuat kekacauan di acara Ines. Ia naik ke atas panggung dan mengancam para penonton. Ines bingung dengan keinginan pria muda tersebut yang marah-marah tanpa alasan. Ines kesal karena penontonnya pergi hingga ia tidak mendapatkan saweran. Kemudian, pria muda tersebut meminta Ines untuk membantunya menyelidiki ayahnya dan calon ibu tirinya yang saat itu sedang dekat. Awalnya Ines menolak, tapi dengan diiming-imingi uang dalam jumlah besar membuat Ines akhirnya bersedia. Ibu Ines kaget saat melihat Ines mendapatkan uang banyak. Ia mengingatkan Ines untuk tidak mencari uang dengan pekerjaan haram. Selanjutnya, Ines dan pria muda itu bertemu lagi. Mereka mulai menyelidiki ayah dan calon ibu tiri si pria muda. Si pria muda sangat yakin kalau calon ibu tirinya yang masih sangat muda hanya menginginkan harta ayahnya saja.

programme.title: Senyum Manis Berhati Sadis
programme.desc: Dekati pacar kembaran sendiri!! buat dia semakin nyaman & jatuh cinta. Clara tidak tau kalau pacarnya punya kembaran!! tapi dia hanya merasa perubahan drastis dari sikapnya. Ternyata kedua lelaki kembar ini dekati Clara hanya karena harta warisan. Apakah clara akan memilih cinta diantara mereka?

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. programme.desc: Senja dan Irina lagi jalan keliling kampus. Kebetulan mereka lewat ruangan Mapala. Di sana ada Bara, ketua Mapala yang banyak ditaksir mahasiswi kampus. programme.title: Operation Seawolf
programme.desc: Angkatan Laut Jerman dan kapal-kapal U-Boat yang tersisa bergabung untuk satu misi terakhir guna menyerang Amerika Serikat.

programme.title: The Great War
programme.desc: Pada hari-hari terakhir Perang Dunia Pertama, sekelompok tentara AS dikirim ke belakang garis musuh untuk menyelamatkan sebuah peleton yang tersesat.

programme.title: Holy Ghost People
programme.desc: Demi menemukan saudarinya, seorang wanita muda menyewa seorang mantan Marinir pecandu alkohol untuk membantunya menyusup ke Gereja Pantekosta One Accord.

programme.title: Burial Ground Massacre
programme.desc: Sekelompok mahasiswa menghabiskan malam di sebuah rumah besar tua yang menyeramkan, hanya untuk menyadari bahwa seorang penguntit yang mengerikan sedang mengawasi setiap gerakan mereka saat ia memulai rencana untuk mengambil alih artefak penduduk asli Amerika kuno yang ada di dalamnya.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tersiksa oleh masa lalunya, seorang petugas kebersihan bernama Clean mencoba menjalani kehidupan yang tenang. Tak lama kemudian, ia dipaksa untuk berdamai dengan kekerasan masa lalunya.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Empat teman ingin pergi ke rumah pedesaan terpencil, tapi kala seorang pria misterius muncul dan menceritakan kisah tentang sebuah kota yang dilanda wabah dan para penjarah mengejarnya, mereka berkumpul untuk membantu.

programme.title: The Hatching
programme.desc: Setelah kematian ayahnya, Tim Webber kembali ke desa asalnya di Sommerset dan menemukan sesuatu nan mengerikan yang mengganggu ketenangan desanya.

programme.title: The Junkyard Dogs
programme.desc: Mengikuti seekor anjing yang merupakan ahli melarikan diri, yang harus bekerja sama dengan teman-teman anak anjingnya untuk mencegah blok mereka dirampok.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Clown Motel
Monster Hunter (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Saat Cpt. Artemis dan tentaranya yang setia diangkut ke dunia baru, mereka terlibat dalam pertempuran putus asa untuk bertahan hidup melawan musuh besar dengan kekuatan luar biasa. Film fitur berdasarkan video game oleh Capcom.

programme.title: The Dark Tower
programme.desc: Seorang bocah yang dihantui oleh bayangan menara kegelapan dari dunia paralel bekerja sama dengan penjaga menara untuk mencegah sesosok mahluk jahat yang ingin menghancurkan menara tersebut dan membuka gerbang neraka.

programme.title: The Taking Of Pelham 123
programme.desc: Orang-orang bersenjata membajak kereta bawah tanah Kota New York, menyandera penumpang dengan imbalan uang tebusan, dan mengubah pekerjaan sehari-hari petugas operator Walter Garber menjadi pertarungan dengan dalang di balik kejahatan tersebut.

programme.title: Armored
programme.desc: Seorang petugas keamanan baru di perusahaan truk lapis baja dipaksa oleh rekan kerjanya yang lebih berpengalaman untuk mencuri sebuah truk berisi 42 juta dolar AS. Namun, sebuah celah dalam rencana mereka yang dianggap sempurna memecah belah kelompok tersebut, yang berpotensi berujung pada situasi yang mematikan.

programme.title: The Social Network
programme.desc: Saat mahasiswa Harvard, Mark Zuckerberg, membuat situs jejaring sosial yang kemudian dikenal sebagai Facebook, ia dituntut secara hukum oleh sepasang saudara kembar yang mengklaim bahwa Mark telah mencuri ide mereka.
Sebuah kisah nyata tentang enam mahasiswa MIT yang dilatih untuk menjadi ahli dalam penghitungan kartu dan kemudian memenangkan jutaan dolar di kasino Las Vegas.
Sebuah kisah nyata tentang enam mahasiswa MIT yang dilatih untuk menjadi ahli dalam penghitungan kartu dan kemudian memenangkan jutaan dolar di kasino Las Vegas.

programme.title: Kill 'Em All
programme.desc: Ketika orang asing misterius tiba di rumah sakit setempat di ambang kematian, interogasi FBI mengungkap rencana balas dendam internasional.

programme.title: Sausage Party
programme.desc: Seekor sosis memimpin sekelompok produk supermarket dalam perjalanan untuk menemukan kebenaran tentang keberadaan mereka dan apa yang sebenarnya terjadi ketika mereka diambil dari rak.

programme.title: The Legend Of Zorro
programme.desc: Meskipun berusaha untuk menjaga agar tindakannya tidak berlebihan, ancaman terhadap status negara bagian California yang tertunda membuat Don Alejandro de la Vega yang menyukai petualangan dan istrinya, Elena, harus bertindak.

programme.title: Resident Evil: Vendetta
programme.desc: Chris Redfield meminta bantuan Leon S. Kennedy dan Rebecca Chambers untuk menghentikan seorang pedagang kematian yang menyebarkan virus mematikan di New York.

programme.title: Total Recall

programme.title: Fun With Japanese
programme.desc: Program edukasi yang dirancang untuk membantu pemirsa memahami keunikan bahasa Jepang melalui penjelasan sederhana dan menarik. Setiap episode fokus pada satu kata atau frasa Jepang, menjelaskan asal-usul, makna, dan penggunaannya dalam kehidupan sehari-hari. Program ini cocok bagi pemula yang ingin memperdalam pengetahuan tentang bahasa dan budaya Jepang.

programme.title: Peek-A-Boo
programme.desc: Peek-a-boo, program edukasi yang dirancang khusus untuk bayi dan balita berusia 0 hingga 2 tahun. Program ini bertujuan untuk merangsang indra bayi melalui gambar dan suara yang cerah dan menarik, serta mendorong interaksi antara anak dan orang tua. Setiap episode berdurasi 15 menit dan menampilkan berbagai karakter lucu, seperti anjing berbulu putih dan boneka berwarna cerah, yang dirancang untuk menarik perhatian dan merangsang perkembangan sensorik anak.

programme.title: With Mother
programme.desc: With Mother adalah program anak-anak yang telah tayang sejak tahun 1959 di NHK, saluran penyiaran publik Jepang. Program ini ditujukan untuk anak-anak usia dini dan menampilkan berbagai segmen seperti lagu musiman, pertunjukan boneka, animasi, dan aktivitas fisik yang melibatkan partisipasi anak-anak.

programme.title: 1-Minute Anime: Songs For SDGs
programme.desc: Program pendek yang menyajikan lagu-lagu bertema Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan (SDGs) dalam format animasi berdurasi satu menit. Setiap episode menampilkan lagu yang mengangkat salah satu dari 17 tujuan SDGs, dengan ilustrasi yang menarik dan mudah dipahami oleh anak-anak. Program ini bertujuan untuk mendidik generasi muda mengenai pentingnya keberlanjutan dan tanggung jawab sosial secara kreatif dan menyenangka/

programme.title: Royal Blood
programme.desc: Tumbuh besar bersama di keluarga ningrat, tidak membuat Anggi dan Saras memiliki kepribadian yang sama. Anggi, sang kakak, memiliki sfat yang bebas. Sedangkan sang adik, Saras, lebih penurut. Meskipun sifat mereka berbeda, tetapi mereka sangat akrab. Mereka memiliki seorang Ayah yang tegas, Ibu yang penyayang, dan Bule yang perhatian serta asisten rumah tangga yang sangat supportive.

programme.title: Date Gone Wrong S1
programme.desc: Kencan pertama biasanya sulit diprediksi; bisa berjalan lancar atau justru sangat buruk. Simak kisah-kisah aneh seputar pengalaman kencan pertama yang dibagikan oleh orang-orang ini.

programme.title: Shubh Mangal Saavdhan
programme.desc: Mudit dan Sugandha sedang bersiap menikah, tapi segalanya berubah saat Mudit menghadapi masalah pribadi yang sensitif. Di tengah tekanan keluarga, mereka belajar makna cinta, kejujuran, dan penerimaan.

programme.title: My Dear Guardian
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah yang mengikuti seorang petugas medis militer yang hangat dan lembut serta seorang perwira militer yang dingin seperti gunung es saat mereka menjalankan tugas, hingga akhirnya menemukan cinta.

programme.title: Ikatan Cinta
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang dua bersaudara, Andin (kakak) dan Elsa (adik). Tanpa mereka sadari mencintai pria yang sama, Nino. Hubungan mereka yang buruk menjadi lebih buruk ketika Elsa tahu bahwa Nino akan menikahi Andin. Pernikahan Nino dan Andin mendapat dukungan sang ayah, namun ditentang oleh sang ibu.

programme.title: Liontin
programme.desc: Manda dan Indy adalah kakak beradik yang saling menyayangi. Ibu mereka, Rianty, meninggal saat melahirkan Indy. Sejak saat itu, Manda dan Indy hanya hidup bertiga bersama ayahnya, Indra. Manda berperan sebagai ibu bagi Indy. Suatu ketika ayah mereka mulai sakit sakitan dan masuk rumah sakit. Ternyata Indra mengidap leukemia.

programme.title: Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Ketika kehilangan mengubah segalanya, Luna harus bangkit, menemukan kembali harapannya dan menghadapi pertemuan yang tak pernah ia duga. Akankah pertemuan itu menjadi awal dari kebahagiaan atau justru membawa luka yang lebih besar?

programme.title: The Munsters
programme.desc: The Skulls, a secret college society whose influence reaches the highest levels of government and business, recruit Ryan Sommers (Robin Dunne), whose future success now seems all but assured. Then one day he sees one of his fraternity brothers kill a young woman -- a crime that Ryan must keep secret if he is to remain a Skull. While Kelly (Lindy Booth), a good friend, pushes him to follow his conscience, Ryan's girlfriend, Ali (Ashley Lyn Cafagna), surprises him by being against his snitching.

programme.desc: Big city girl Melissa Morgan tries to make new friends in the small Texas town she just moved to. The only problem is, each of the boys that she spends time with ends up brutally murdered. Her sixteenth birthday is on the way, but Melissa turns out to be a suspect when it seems she's the last person who has seen her boyfriends alive.

programme.title: In Hell
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Body Bags [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A creepy-looking coroner (John Carpenter) introduces three different horror tales involving his current work which are cadavers in "body bags."

programme.title: Flight 666
programme.desc: Passengers on an international flight are attacked by unseen forces. As they fight to stay alive, they realize who is controlling the attacks.

programme.title: The Pit
programme.desc: A solitary and strange preteen boy wreaks vengeance on his harassers when he makes a disturbing discovery in the depths of a forest.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: A Bucket Of Blood
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries her hand at being an artist in a variety of mediums. Also, Breather presents the Mistress of the Dark with The Publisher's Wet T-Shirt Contest Award.

programme.title: Shark Attack 3: Megalodon
programme.desc: In the third installment of the "Shark Attack" saga, marine researchers make a startling discovery: the most menacing beast that ever ruled these waters is still alive.

programme.title: House of Bones
programme.desc: A team of TV ghost hunters travel to investigate a haunted house surrounded by rumors. Upon their arrival, they find a foreboding house with a mind of its own. With Corin Nemec ("Stargate SG-1") and Charisma Carpenter ("Angel").

programme.title: Alligator II: The Mutation
programme.desc: A police detective (Joseph Bologna) teams up with a Cajun hunter (Richard Lynch) to find a giant killer-reptile in the city sewers.

programme.title: Alligator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A baby alligator is flushed down a Chicago toilet and survives by eating discarded laboratory rats injected with growth hormones.

programme.title: House (1985) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

programme.title: Apollo 18
programme.desc: Apollo 17 was the last U.S.-sponsored lunar voyage -- or was it? Hours of found footage, classified for decades, point to a subsequent moon mission -- Apollo 18 -- that ended very badly. Astronauts John Grey (Ryan Robbins), Nathan Walker (Lloyd Owen) and Benjamin Anderson (Warren Christie), on a mission to install radar scanners, discover a Soviet space capsule nearby. The men also discover a dead cosmonaut, and unfortunately for them, learn how he died.

programme.title: Puppet Master
programme.desc: Assailed by nightmarish visions, Alex Whitaker (Paul Le Mat) and his fellow psychics descend on the Bodega Bay Inn. There, they discover that their compatriot Neil (Jimmie F. Scaggs) has apparently committed suicide. But, as the gruesome visions continue, they sense that there's still something sinister afoot. When they find themselves hunted by a band of homicidal marionettes created by twisted puppeteer Andre Toulon (William Hickey), they discover they're right.

programme.title: Curtains
programme.desc: Six young actresses auditioning for a movie role at a remote mansion are targeted by a mysterious masked murderer.

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.

programme.title: Hollow Creek
programme.desc: Trying to find inspiration for his next horror novel, Blake retreats to the Appalachian Mountains with his mistress, Angelica. When she disappears, Blake becomes a prime suspect.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira prepares to compete on a game show while hosting "The Brain That Wouldn't Die."

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Crocodile
programme.desc: A group of friends goes on a boat trip - but their joyful weekend turns into horror when a giant killer crocodile, searching for its stolen eggs, picks off anyone who gets in its way.

programme.title: Maneater
programme.desc: Townspeople must venture deep into the woods to save their isolated town from an escaped Bengal tiger.

programme.title: Dominion: Prequel To The Exorcist [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Haunted by terrible acts the Nazis forced him to participate in, the disenchanted Father Lankester Merrin focuses his energies on helping with an archaeological dig in the northern part of Kenya. There, the crew uncovers a church that predates Christian missions into the area, but the discovery also causes strange events to start occurring -- including physical changes to a young, disabled boy, whom Merrin grows to suspect has been possessed by a demon.

programme.title: Black Christmas [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: Some curious students visit an abandoned school and learn its shameful history isn't fully in the past. Their trip turns into a fight for survival.

programme.title: An American Werewolf in Paris
programme.desc: A group of carousing American tourists is taking in the cultural landmarks of Paris when a chance encounter results in sightseer Andy McDermott (Tom Everett Scott) saving the life of Parisian Serafine Pigot (Julie Delpy). While on a date at a nightclub with Serafine, Andy is suddenly attacked and bitten by a werewolf. The next day he discovers that Serafine is also a lycanthrope, and that he is beginning his own grueling, hirsute transformation into one of the fanged beasts.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 2
programme.desc: Renegade police officer Matthew Cordell (Robert Z'Dar) once roamed the streets of New York City unleashing his murderous brand of vigilante justice upon its denizens before being struck down by good cop Jack Forrest (Bruce Campbell). Now, Forrest is eager to move on from those heinous events, but he is stopped short when a familiar killing spree begins. Though thought dead and gone, Cordell is back from the grave and ready to wreak his merciless havoc once more.

programme.title: Charlie's Farm
programme.desc: Four friends go into Australia's outback to explore the site where a violent family met its end at the hands of an angry mob. Despite all warnings, they persist in their terrifying adventure.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
programme.desc: Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.

programme.title: Eraserhead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happil
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie's photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn't stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready - steady - and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there's a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK - ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE

programme.title: The Jackie Robinson Story
programme.desc: After a successful baseball career in college and as a coach in the military, Jackie Robinson (playing himself) attracts the attention of Major League Baseball's Branch Rickey (Minor Watson). Rickey wants Robinson to play in the minor leagues, believing he can become the first player to break the color barrier and play in the majors. The only catch: He is forbidden from defending himself against racial bigotry. Supported by his wife (Ruby Dee), Robinson is steadfast in his determination to win.

programme.title: Get the Girl
programme.desc: When a strange girl appears do you help, or mind your business? A retired hitman and his trainee get pulled into the shit when they decide to save a girl who escapes from trafficking. Sometimes you gotta do bad things to bad people.

programme.title: Xanadu Hellfire
programme.desc: A nine-year-old brings a warrior from the future to the present and an evil follows. An amazingly cool and funny Sci-fi comedy with kids cursing, lasers, time travel, aliens, martial arts, and more!

programme.title: A Rough Draft
programme.desc: A video game designer is stripped of his identity and recruited by a mysterious force to be the gatekeeper of a multi-dimensional portal.

programme.title: Awaken
programme.desc: Cafe owner Alex's love life is ignited when Rachel walks through his doors. What begins as a shot of love quickly spins into a mystery spanning space and time when Alex discovers the woman of his dreams may only exist in his dreams.

programme.title: Rain Beau's End
programme.desc: When a progressive lesbian couple adopts a boy with a misunderstood genetic condition that was thought to predispose boys to violence and criminality, they must come to grips with their hardline stance on acceptance and toxic masculinity.

programme.title: Slant
programme.desc: Melbourne. 1999. Christmas time! In this darkly comic thriller, a rogue journalist unearths the sordid secrets of an infamous missing socialite for the scoop of a lifetime while unwittingly dredging up his family trauma.

programme.title: Retribution
programme.desc: Dan's mission becomes a race against time to ensure that in Retribution - everybody pays.

programme.title: Molli and Max in the Future
programme.desc: A sci-fi rom-com about a man and woman whose orbits repeatedly collide over the course of 12 years, 4 planets, 3 dimensions, and 1 space-cult. Molli and Max in the Future combines character-driven romance with an eclectic sci-fi universe.

programme.title: Little Sister
programme.desc: Young nun Colleen (Addison Timlin) is avoiding all contact with her family until an email from her mother announces that her brother is home. Upon returning to her childhood home in Asheville, N.C., she finds her old room exactly how she left it - painted black and covered in goth/metal posters. Although her parents are happy to see her, unease and awkwardness abound, and her brother is living as a recluse in the guesthouse since returning home from the war in Iraq.

programme.title: Get a Job
programme.desc: Unemployed and living with the "mother-in-law from hell," a young comedian and his childhood friend are sucked into the ride of their lives when they decide there is no time like the present to pursue their dreams of opening a comedy club.

programme.title: Succuba
programme.desc: An evil presence attaches to a lonely widower who intends to guard it for as long as he can.

programme.title: The Battery
programme.desc: The personalities of two former baseball players clash as they traverse the rural back roads of a post-plague New England teeming with the undead.

programme.title: Fighting for Freedom
programme.desc: A Mexican couple have two children in the US, but when they return to Mexico and have another child there, they are denied re-entry. They decide to return illegally, but the authorities eventually seek to deport their Mexican-born child.

programme.title: When Jeff Tried to Save the World
programme.desc: When Jeff, the manager of an old-school bowling alley, discovers the owner's plans to sell, he has to use the things around him, including a high school stoner, a perverted janitor, a 90-year-old bowling champion, a sassy kitchen worker, and the occasional drug-induced conversation with Pac-Man, to save it.

programme.title: Amber Road
programme.desc: The Amber Road is a place in the digital universe where anything can be bought, sold, and traded: a place where a person can fulfill their darkest desire or unleash their deepest depravity.

programme.title: Reflections on the Living Dead
programme.desc: Director George A. Romero, co-writer John A. Russo, and producers Russell W. Streiner and Karl Hardman gather for the first time in 25 years for a once-in-a-lifetime roundtable discussion on the making of "Night of the Living Dead."

programme.title: My King
programme.desc: A young woman has found the perfect man in her life. Problems arise when his mother starts to interfere in their business.

programme.title: Miles in the Life: The Story of a BMF Drug Trafficker
programme.desc: Using the cover of an Atlanta limousine driver, Jabari Hayes trafficked large quantities of cocaine across the country for the then-largest African American drug organization in the southeast known as Black Mafia Family, often referred to as BMF.

programme.title: Asperger's Are Us
programme.desc: In this coming-of-age documentary, four friends on the Autism spectrum who have bonded through humor and performed as the comedy troupe "Asperger's Are Us" will prepare for one final, ambitious show before going their separate ways.

programme.title: Upstairs Inferno
programme.desc: For over 40 years, the 1973 New Orleans gay bar arson was considered the "Largest Gay Mass Murder in US History." Featuring heart-wrenching interviews with survivors, friends of victims, and witnesses, the film vividly examines the forgotten tragedy.

programme.title: Love You Right: An R&B Musical

programme.desc: A cop who loses his partner in a shoot-out with gun smugglers goes on a mission to catch them. In order to get closer to the leaders of the ring he joins forces with an undercover cop who's working as a gangster hitman. They use all means of excessive force to find them.

programme.title: The Bodyguard From Beijing

programme.title: Prison on Fire
programme.desc: Yiu (Tony Leung Ka Fai) is a young advertising executive in Hong Kong. One night, defending his father from attack, he accidentally shoves a street thug in front of a bus. Sentenced to three years in prison, Yiu is "fresh meat" for the hardened criminals and triad stooges that run things, and is preyed upon by sadistic guard Scarface (Roy Cheung). The virtuous Ching (Chow Yun-Fat) intervenes, teaching him the ropes of prison life, and a tender friendship develops between the two.

programme.title: Prison on Fire 2
programme.desc: Ching escapes from prison to see his young son who has been put in an orphanage.

programme.title: Brotherhood of the Wolf
programme.desc: In a rural province of France, a mysterious creature is laying waste to the countryside, savagely killing scores of women and children. Unseen, possessed of enormous strength and a human intelligence, the beast has eluded capture for years. King Louis sends in a renowned scientist and his Iroquois blood brother, an unconventional team whose combined methods and capabilities may bring the beast down. But the true nature of the beast is not what anyone could have anticipated.

programme.title: Living in Oblivion
programme.desc: Independent film director Nick Reve is making his first feature. Everything that can go wrong does: the rebellious catering crew refuses to replace spoiled milk, his actors are flaky and getting an unspoiled take is nearly impossible. Tension between lead actress Nicole and actor Chad, who have just slept together, contributes to the many problems on set. As money and time run out, Nick struggles to complete his film.

programme.title: Red Headed Stranger
programme.desc: The Rev. Shay moves out West to set up his new home in Montana so that he can spread God's word. But when his wife, Raysha, leaves him for another man -- in part because she wants to return to Philadelphia -- the reverend decides to replace his spiritual ways with a gun. After shooting down his wife and her lover, he battles a landowner intent on keeping all the town's water for himself. But his deadly ways make him yearn for a belief in God again.

programme.title: Journey to the End of the Night
programme.desc: Sinatra and his adult son, Paul, live on the edge of the law in the Brazilian urban jungle of São Paulo. They make a meager living running a brothel, but what profits they make Paul gambles away. When a customer dies on their premises, leaving behind a suitcase brimming with drugs, Sinatra sees a way to start a new life for his new wife and her young child. But his scheme quickly gets complicated when Paul sees the opportunity to take a calculated risk.

programme.title: Hopscotch

Kendig beats him to it, however, destroying his own records and traveling to Austria where he begins work on a memoir that will expose all his former agency's covert practices. The CIA catches wind of the book and sends other agents after him, initiating a frenetic game of cat and mouse that spans the globe.

programme.title: Killer Elite [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Danny Bryce (Jason Statham), one of the world's deadliest special-ops agents, returns from self-imposed exile after his mentor, Hunter (Robert De Niro) is captured. Danny reassembles his former team of skilled commandos to launch a rescue mission, and also to infiltrate the highly feared military unit, the British Special Air Service. The mission will not be easy, for Danny and his team must cut their way through Spike (Clive Owen) and a team of assassins known as the Feather Men.

programme.title: Concrete Canyons
programme.desc: In this thrilling crime drama, a sheriff searches for his son who is accused of murder and on the run from the law.

programme.title: Point Break [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Jesus Of Nazareth
programme.desc: An all-star cast comes together to deliver a powerful adaptation of the Gospels in 1977's Jesus Of Nazareth.

programme.title: I'm Beginning to See the Light
programme.desc: After losing his family in a brutal accident, ex-trumpeter Ezra finds solace as a lighthouse keeper. But when two visitors reveal their true motives, Ezra must decide: let the light back into his life or stay in the shadows.

programme.title: The Temptations
programme.desc: The true story behind the legendary Motown musical sensation is brought to life in this touching miniseries.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove
programme.desc: Texas Rangers and long-time ranching partners Gus McCrae and Woodrow Call meet their old friend Jake, and decide to strike out from their south Texas base and drive a cattle herd to Montana.

programme.title: Wind and Bone
programme.desc: A woman on the run joins a group of college students in rural West Virginia, where they soon encounter the Wendigo.

programme.title: Timecop [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: When mankind perfects time travel, the government establishes the Time Enforcement Commission to thwart criminal attempts to alter the timeline. Police officer Walker (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is recruited by TEC Cmdr. Matuzak (Bruce McGill), but soon finds his investigation of Senator Aaron McComb (Ron Silver) being thwarted by elements within the government. When Walker's wife, Melissa (Mia Sara), is attacked, he must travel across time to rescue her and save the future.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: Tomorrow Before After
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic world, a lone woman searches for survivors while coping with an unborn child growing inside her.

programme.title: The Fix
programme.desc: When a troubled model takes a new drug at a party, she suffers a shocking transformation. Pursued by authorities and a dangerous gang, she hunts for a 'fix' to reverse these effects, only to discover her mutations could save the human race.

programme.title: Brother Orange
programme.desc: In 2014, BuzzFeed writer Matt Stopera's phone was stolen from a bar in New York City. A year later, photos of storefronts and a man next to an orange tree mysteriously appeared in his iPhoto stream. Matt wrote an article about it, and overnight, it went viral in China, where internet users identified the man as "Brother Orange." Matt became an instant celebrity, and as media followed their every move, he and Brother Orange formed a deep friendship that transcended cultural and language barriers.

programme.title: Judy Moody And The Not Bummer Summer
programme.desc: Judy (Jordana Beatty) has planned the most awesome summer ever and can't wait to have adventures with her best friends, Rocky and Amy. Then she finds out that Rocky is off to tame lions and that Amy is flying to Borneo with her mother to save a lost tribe. Judy is bummed to be left home with her rotten brother, Stink (Parris Mosteller), and her second-best friend, Frank Pearl. And, what's worse, her parents go to California and leave her with an aunt (Heather Graham) she's never even met.

programme.title: The Ron Clark Story
programme.desc: In his small North Carolina hometown, Ron Clark (Matthew Perry) leads a comfortable life as a successful elementary school teacher, earning the respect of the community. However, he knows there are students elsewhere who need him more. Following his inner calling, Clark uproots to New York City, hoping to make a difference for the disenfranchised youths the school system has left behind. Clark makes it his mission to turn around the worst students, even though he knows his job is on the line.

programme.title: In Hell
programme.desc: Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity.

programme.title: Paradox Effect
programme.desc: estranged from her daughter because of a past life of drug-abuse, Karina is taking all the steps she can towards being the mother she needs to be. One night Karina hears the discharge of a muted weapon and a body breaking through heavy glass. Looking up, she locks eyes with the man who pulled the trigger and she is captured. The mastermind of it all is crime lord Silvio and his vicious gangsters who forces Karina and Covek, a deadly killer threatened by him, to go on a journey against time.

programme.title: A Great Divide
programme.desc: The Lee family leave the Bay Area for a fresh start in the rural expanses of Wyoming, only to encounter hostility and xenophobia in their new community. How they confront these issues will break them - or make them stronger.

programme.title: Direct Contact
programme.desc: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given a chance at freedom if he can rescue a kidnapped woman.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Theatrical Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit crimes.

programme.title: In Flight
programme.desc: The night before Claire Reynolds' trip to Paris, she catches the eye of a mysterious, handsome stranger. That's the last thing she remembers before waking up on a plane with no recollection of what happened after that.

programme.title: The Dark Crystal
programme.desc: Jen, raised by the noble race called the Mystics, has been told that he is the last survivor of his own race, the Gelflings. He sets out to try to find a shard of the dark crystal, a powerful gem that once provided balance to the universe. After the crystal was broken, the evil Skeksis used sinister means to gain control. Jen believes that he can repair the dark crystal and bring peace back to the world, if he can only find the remaining shard.

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: Dr Lehman and his assistant Imogene join forces to avert a looming disaster. They strive to divert a meteor hurtling towards Earth, determined to save humanity from impending doom.

programme.title: The Lost Princess
programme.desc: A billionaire gets transported to a bloody battle that leads him to an old castle in Morocco. He soon meets Hanna, who shares the tragic tale of her mother's forced marriage to a Saudi prince, and her secret love affair with a castle caretaker.

programme.title: My ID is Gangnam Beauty
programme.desc: The students are offered an opportunity to sign up for a lab program with Kellun. Woo Young decides its time to make a move.

programme.title: The Dude In Me
programme.desc: Pan-soo a successful businessman in his 40s is hit on the ground by a person falling from a building. Waking up he finds himself in another body. Now Pan-soo has to be Dong- hyun a high school student who gets bullied frequently. He finds out Dong-hyun tried to help a girl Hyun-jung and fell off the building. When he meets her mother Mi-sun he immediately knows that Hyun-jeong is his daughter. To get close to Hyun-jung Pan-soo takes hard physical training with her.

programme.title: Lost in the Moonlight
programme.desc: Hyunjuli who accidentally falls into a fantasy world of the Moonlit Palace fights against the evil Blossom Lady to protect her new friends.

programme.title: Come Rain, Come Shine
programme.desc: On the day of parting a couple still play hide and seek with their feelings. Will this being them back together?

programme.title: Fortune Salon
programme.desc: Tae-rang is a successful upscale clairvoyant with not only gifted shamanistic talent but also good looks. Yet fate has it that she is destined to marry Seung-won the most unattractive and lazy man she has ever met.
A girl dreaming of a civil servant to support her mother gets into an accident and is framed as a murderer.

programme.title: The Tiger
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation of Korea, a fallen hunter faces the tiger he once spared as their fates collide in a final, tragic showdown.
A girl dreaming of a civil servant to support her mother gets into an accident and is framed as a murderer.

programme.title: Best Friend
programme.desc: Dae-kwon is a NIS agent specializing in wiretapping. On the verge of demotion he receives an order from Mr. Kim his senior: surveilling a well-known politician and his family in house arrest. That politician Lee Eui-min is the opposition party's frontrunner for the next presidency. Disguising as next-door neighbors Dae-kwon and his team must find evidence to stop him from running.

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: Nick Morton is a soldier of fortune who plunders ancient sites for timeless artifacts and sells them to the highest bidder. When Nick and his partner come under attack in the Middle East, the ensuing battle accidentally unearths Ahmanet, a betrayed Egyptian princess who was entombed under the desert for thousands of years. With her powers constantly evolving, Morton must now stop the resurrected monster as she embarks on a furious rampage through the streets of London.

programme.title: The Scorpion King 2: Rise of a Warrior
programme.desc: After a swarm of enchanted scorpions kills his father, Mathayus (Michael Copon) flees and vows to even the score with ruthless sorcerer Sargon (Randy Couture). Upon returning home after years of combat training, Mathayus finds that Sargon has seized the crown and protected himself with a powerful spell. To retrieve the only weapon capable of destroying the tyrant -- a mystical sword -- Mathayus and lady warrior Layla (Karen David) set off for a labyrinth guarded by a deadly Minotaur.

programme.title: The Scorpion King 4: Quest for Power
programme.desc: Mathayus is framed for the murder of the king of Norvania, and he and his allies have to stop the evil heir from finding a mythical power.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: Nick Morton is a soldier of fortune who plunders ancient sites for timeless artifacts and sells them to the highest bidder. When Nick and his partner come under attack in the Middle East, the ensuing battle accidentally unearths Ahmanet, a betrayed Egyptian princess who was entombed under the desert for thousands of years. With her powers constantly evolving, Morton must now stop the resurrected monster as she embarks on a furious rampage through the streets of London.

programme.title: The Watcher
programme.desc: The Watcher is an exciting psychological thriller that takes a unique look into the minds of both a serial killer and the man who must, reluctantly, pursue him. In an almost Hitchcockian way, the film quickly introduces us to the killer, David Allen Griffin, played by Keanu Reeves, who for many years, preyed on lonely young women in the Los Angeles area. The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

programme.title: Black Christmas
programme.desc: Hawthorne College is quieting down for the holidays as students travel home to spend time with their families. But as Riley and her sorority sisters prepare to deck the halls with seasonal parties, a mysterious cloaked figure starts to leave a bloody trail throughout the campus. Refusing to become hapless victims, Riley and her friends decide to band together and fight back against the psychotic Christmas killer.

programme.title: Dead Silence
programme.desc: After his wife meets a grisly end, Jamie Ashen (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their creepy hometown of Ravens Fair to unravel the mystery of her murder. Once there, he discovers the legend of Mary Shaw (Joan Heney), a murdered ventriloquist whose eerie presence still looms over the town. As he desperately digs for answers, Jamie encounters the curse that took his wife's life and threatens his own.

programme.title: The Unborn
programme.desc: Plagued by nightmares and visitations from tortured ghosts, Casey Beldon turns to a spiritual adviser named Sendak for help. They discover a family curse that dates back to Nazi Germany: an evil spirit that can take over the body of anyone and is getting stronger with each possession, as it tries to gain full entrance to this world.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Slither
programme.desc: Wheelsy is a small town where not much happens and everyone minds his own business. No one notices when evil slips in quietly but when people find mutilated livestock and a woman goes missing, Sheriff Bill Pardy discovers an alien organism that threatens to devour all life on Earth.

programme.title: Devil
programme.desc: Five strangers' day begins with an elevator ride in a Philadelphia office tower. But, what happens next is anything but ordinary. The elevator gets stuck, and the trapped passengers, who expected to be together just a few minutes, now face the revelation of their secrets and transgressions. Frightening events turn annoyance into terror, as they begin to realize that one of their number is Lucifer himself.

programme.title: The Visit
programme.desc: Becca and younger brother Tyler say goodbye to their mother as they board a train and head deep into Pennsylvania farm country to meet their maternal grandparents for the first time. Welcomed by Nana and Pop Pop, all seems well until the siblings start to notice increasingly strange behavior from the seemingly charming couple. Once the children discover a shocking secret, they begin to wonder if they'll ever make it home.

programme.title: The Frighteners
programme.desc: Once an architect, Frank Bannister (Michael J. Fox) now passes himself off as an exorcist of evil spirits. To bolster his facade, he claims his "special" gift is the result of a car accident that killed his wife. But what he does not count on is more people dying in the small town where he lives. As he tries to piece together the supernatural mystery of these killings, he falls in love with the wife (Trini Alvarado) of one of the victims and deals with a crazy FBI agent (Jeffrey Combs).

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: On an Arctic expedition, Stanley Shepard discovers Charlie, a Neanderthal man frozen in ice. With a team of scientists, Shepard revives Charlie and learns that he has been cryogenically suspended for 40,000 years. Stanley grows close to Charlie as he observes the man and learns about his prehistoric culture -- but when the media catches on to the discovery, Stanley must protect Charlie from fellow scientists who want to use his corpse for scientific research.

programme.title: Sssssss
programme.desc: Short on cash, undergrad David Blake (Dirk Benedict) takes a job working as a lab assistant for snake expert Dr. Carl Stoner (Strother Martin). When Stoner begins giving David a series of antibiotics as a safeguard against snakebites, he at first thinks nothing of it. But gradually David begins to notice curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Could Dr. Stoner really be trying to turn his assistant into a snake?

programme.title: The Andromeda Strain
programme.desc: Chilling tale about a US research satellite carrying a deadly extraterrestrial microscopic organism that crashes into a small town in Arizona. A group of top scientists are hurriedly assembled in a bid to identify and contain the lethal stowaway. Based on the novel by Michael Crichton.

programme.title: Junior
programme.desc: A research scientist becomes the world's first pregnant man in order to test a drug he and a colleague have designed for expectant women. To carry out the trial, he has an embryo implant, believing that he will only carry the baby for three months - hardly expecting to face the prospect of giving birth.

programme.title: Twins
programme.desc: The products of a genetic experiment, fraternal twins Julius (Arnold Schwarzenegger) and Vincent (Danny DeVito) are separated at birth. Their mother, Mary Ann (Bonnie Bartlett), is told they're dead. Now Vincent, an unscrupulous street hustler, ekes out a living in Los Angeles. Julius, raised by a scientist (Tony Jay), grows up humble, intelligent and strong, but very naive about the larger world. When Julius learns of his mother and brother, he heads to Los Angeles to find his family.

programme.title: Bird on a Wire
programme.desc: Rick Jarmin (Mel Gibson) is put in witness protection after he helps the FBI bust drug dealer Eugene Sorenson (David Carradine). Fifteen years later, he is living with a new identity as a gas station attendant in Detroit. When an old flame named Marianne (Goldie Hawn) stops at the gas station and recognizes him, his cover gets blown. The recently released Sorenson finds out, and both Jarmin and Marianne have to flee across the country with the vengeful Sorenson in hot pursuit.

programme.title: For Love or Money
programme.desc: New York concierge Doug Ireland (Michael J. Fox) wants to go into business for himself and refurbish a hotel on Roosevelt Island, N.Y., but he needs an investor. With a few weeks left before his option on the site runs out, Doug agrees to help wealthy Christian Hanover (Anthony Higgins) conceal his affair with salesgirl Andy Hart (Gabrielle Anwar) from his wife. Despite his own attraction to Andy, Doug tries to stay focused on getting Christian to invest $3 million in his project.

programme.title: Ted 2
programme.desc: Life has changed drastically for thunder buddies John (Mark Wahlberg), now a bachelor, and best pal Ted (Seth MacFarlane), now married to the woman (Jessica Barth) of his dreams. Problems arise when the couple decide to adopt a child, but the law declares Ted to be property and not a person. Angry and dejected, the lovably foulmouthed teddy bear must now seek legal help from a young lawyer (Amanda Seyfried) and a legendary, civil-rights attorney (Morgan Freeman) to get the justice he deserves.

programme.title: A Million Ways to Die in the West
programme.desc: Mild-mannered sheep farmer Albert Stark (Seth MacFarlane) feels certain that the Western frontier is trying to kill him, then he loses his girlfriend, Louise (Amanda Seyfried), to the town's most successful businessman. However, a beautiful, pistol-packing woman named Anna (Charlize Theron) rides into town and helps Albert find his inner courage. Then Stark must put his newfound bravery to the test when Anna's outlaw husband arrives with plans to plant him in an unmarked grave.

programme.title: Doomsday
programme.desc: When the first outbreak of the Reaper virus hit Scotland, Eden Sinclair was one of the last to escape containment and had to leave her mother behind. Twenty-five years later, Maj. Eden Sinclair (Rhona Mitra) leads a team back into the hot zone to find a counteragent to the virus, which has re-emerged in London. She and her comrades wage a desperate battle for survival against feral survivors, as they try to prevent it from ushering in a new dark age.

programme.title: The Purge: Anarchy
programme.desc: One night per year, the government sanctions a 12-hour period in which citizens can commit any crime they wish -- including murder -- without fear of punishment or imprisonment. Leo, a sergeant who lost his son, plans a vigilante mission of revenge during the mayhem. However, instead of a death-dealing avenger, he becomes the unexpected protector of four innocent strangers who desperately need his help if they are to survive the night.

programme.title: The Hitcher
programme.desc: Grace and Jim are a pair of college students on their way to spring break in a 1970 Oldsmobile. Blissfully unaware of the horror that awaits them, they offer a ride to hitchhiker John Ryder, a killer who subsequently terrorizes the couple and implicates them in a grisly slaying.

programme.title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers
programme.desc: Kimberly helps the Rangers' ancestors morph into Wild West Rangers to save the world.

programme.title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers
programme.desc: Rita and Zedd create an evil Blue Ranger from a high school art project.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour.
